parts.name: האפיון
parts.proof: spec/ holds the reviewed spec and the decision log; the owner decisions are listed

parts.name: הנתונים
parts.proof: db/data.md exists, every table has RLS on, and the permission table covers every role

parts.name: השירות
parts.proof: signup, login and the three roles work live; a webhook call without the secret is refused

parts.name: דף המכירה
parts.proof: the flow reaches the order summary and the order row is saved as pending payment

parts.name: פאנל הניהול
parts.proof: an owner edits content and publishes an article without code; the business dashboard loads

parts.name: דשבורד המפתח
parts.proof: visits, sales, faults and the change log show for developers only; an owner session gets refused

parts.name: הסוכן הדואלי
parts.proof: the owner mode opens only for the owner account id; a customer account stays in customer mode

parts.name: האישור האנושי
parts.proof: an outgoing email, offer or publish waits for approval and does not go out without it

parts.name: האוטומציה
parts.proof: one flow runs by schedule or event with no click; the executions list shows the run

parts.name: מערכת ההתראות
parts.proof: docs/alerts.md maps the critical points and a forced fault sends an email

parts.name: ה-API
parts.proof: docs/api.md lists three capabilities with keys; a call without a key returns 401

parts.name: מוכן לסוכני AI
parts.proof: five readiness checks pass, including robots.txt, the sitemap and Markdown content

parts.name: הסקילים
parts.proof: a design system skill and a go-live skill are packed as a plugin with a version number

parts.name: הוק CI/CD
parts.proof: a push to production without passing tests and approval is blocked; a feature needs a branch and a pull request

parts.name: הבדיקות
parts.proof: evals/ holds at least 20 checks in the six types and the report shows two runs

parts.name: המסירה
parts.proof: docs/ holds the owner guide, the next developer document and the acceptance test result

parts.name: הסרטון והמצגת
parts.proof: a video of five to seven minutes and a deck are in docs/, and the video shows the main flow live
